content.title: WEG W22-5HP-4P-B3 - 5 HP TEFC Induction Motor, 460V, 3-Phase, 1750 RPM, Frame 184T, IE3
content.short_description: WEG W22-5HP-4P-B3 is a 5 HP (3.729 kW) three-phase TEFC induction motor rated 460V/60Hz, 1750 RPM, frame 184T, foot mounted (B3), IE3 premium efficiency.
content.long_description:
The WEG W22-5HP-4P-B3 is a totally enclosed fan-cooled (TEFC) squirrel cage induction motor built on a 184T frame with B3 foot mounting. It is rated for 5 HP (3.729 kW) output at 1750 RPM on a 460V, three-phase, 60 Hz supply.

The motor meets IE3 premium efficiency classification. Enclosure type is TEFC, suited for environments requiring protection of internal windings from dust and liquids while dissipating heat via an external fan and enclosed frame design.

Frame size 184T and B3 foot mounting allow direct replacement or specification against NEMA-standard footprint and shaft height requirements for pumps, fans, compressors, and general industrial drive applications operating on 460V three-phase power at 60 Hz.
